payload.description_html: Size of Nanuqsaurus compared to other theropods. A, Nanuqsaurus hoglundi, based on holotype, DMNH 21461. B, Tyrannosaurus rex, based on FMNH PR2081. C, Tyrannosaurus rex, based on AMNH 5027. D, Daspletosaurus torosus, based on FMNH PR308. E, Albertosaurus sarcophagus, based on TMP 81.10.1. F, Troodon formosus, lower latitude individual based on multiple sources and size estimates. G, Troodon sp., North Slope individual based on extrapolation from measurements of multiple dental specimens. Scale bar equals 1 m.
